author: Parsifal-2045
body:
#### PR description:

This PR adds the missing data dictionaries for classes used by persistent products in the Phase-2 RelVal inputs. Without them, ROOT reads these classes through the interpreter (cling) or streamer emulation, which is significantly slower:

- `DataFormats/L1TParticleFlow`: `edm::Ptr<l1t::PFCandidate>`, `l1ct::JetTagClass` and `std::pair<edm::Ptr<l1t::L1Candidate>,float>`, and their vectors (used by `l1t::PFJet` and `l1t::PFCluster`)
- `DataFormats/L1TMuonPhase2`: `l1t::SAMuonRefVector` (used by `l1t::TrackerMuon`)
- `DataFormats/EcalDigi`: `std::vector<EcalEBTriggerPrimitiveSample>` (used by `EcalEBTriggerPrimitiveDigi`)

The missing dictionaries were found with the warning added in #52201.

No change in the physics output is expected.

#### PR validation:

- The packages build, including the class version check, and the unit tests
- Tested together with #52201 on a Phase-2 HLT workflow removed the related warnings
title: Add missing data dictionaries for HLT inputs
